payload.instruction: Make this look like a comic book photo
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the edited image fully look like a comic-book photo?
node.criteria: Complete only when the evidence establishes the requested comic-book-photo appearance as a whole. Partial only when requested progress is established and evidence also establishes that the overall requested appearance remains incomplete. Absent when evidence establishes no requested progress. Unknown when necessary evidence is unresolved; do not infer failure from operational errors. Photographic retention alone is not progress, and a styling cue or progress observation alone does not establish completion or incompleteness. Ignore unrelated edits.
node.binding: Target: The image visibly combines comic-book styling with a photographic appearance.. Reference: The supplied image, as edited; assess the overall visual treatment for comic-book styling and photographic subject matter..

outcome.description: Transform the image so it has a comic-book visual style while retaining its photographic subject matter.
outcome.target: The image visibly combines comic-book styling with a photographic appearance.
outcome.reference: The supplied image, as edited; assess the overall visual treatment for comic-book styling and photographic subject matter.
